policy_definition.implementation: one classically fixed recycle constant per candidate-policy probability oracle

precision_screen.budget_definition: p95 collapsed stream-to-event quantization error <= 10% of nested-held-out phase-stream p95 error for purity and recovery, with all candidate-policy float labels retained

verification.complete_oracle_inverse: exact Qiskit circuit inverse after CZ on retained purity/recovery flags

claim_boundary.supported: policy-specific reversible construction of feed-H2, external-product-H2, and external-impurity registers directly from encoded adsorption phase-start states and shared parameters, followed by joint purity/recovery phase marking and exact uncomputation
claim_boundary.unsupported: physical repeated-cycle CSS, coherent superposition over the three classically enumerated policies, state preparation, backend routing/noise, external H2 validation, or quantum advantage
